doc.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Poconos festival
summary: The jazz festival begun by musicians and its funding cuts.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: That’s a great festival, by the way.

Yeah it is. It’s the only festival in the world that was begun by jazz musicians and continues. But we’re having a little trouble. We don’t get the … grants have been cut back. We used to get money from the state but that no longer applies so um, eh, we’ll make it.
